image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) adhering to a rough, rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a textured, leathery girdle. The plates exhibit intricate growth lines and mottled brownish-grey coloration.
